patch_description: Following the recommendation to complement the ZZ entangling shells with orthogonal Y-basis coupling, I add a YY entangling shell on the same skip-2 qubit pairs ([0,2],[1,3],[2,4],[3,5],[4,6],[5,7],[6,0],[7,1]) immediately after the existing ZZ skip-2 shell. Crucially, this reuses the SAME shared parameter name "zz_ring" already used for all ZZ couplings, so no new trainable parameter is introduced (n_distinct_params stays at 4). Adding YY interactions in addition to ZZ on the same connectivity pattern increases the reachable entangled state space (since [XX,YY,ZZ] generators don't commute), which should help the circuit separate harder validation groups without any parameter-count penalty, echoing the successful ZZ-density strategy from prior high-scoring seeds but adding a complementary rotation axis.
